data.narrative: The student implemented a DB-native full-text search API with PostgreSQL using parameterized queries and offset-limit pagination logic. Scoping is correctly enforced at the owner level, and page_size capping prevents database overload scenarios. Safe pagination boundaries were verified with boundary tests.

dimension_scores.observation: Decided on DB-native search to avoid Meilisearch/Elasticsearch infrastructure complexity given the current dataset scale and consistency requirements.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose choice A (DB-native search) in DECIDE step with strong operational simplicity reasoning.

dimension_scores.observation: Added pagination boundary tests to verify ge=1, le=100 and offset constraints, validating against custom 400 Bad Request error handlers.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added test_search_pagination_boundaries in test_search.py and verified with pytest.

dimension_scores.observation: Prevented SQL injection attacks by using SQLAlchemy's secure parameter binding and validated the 401 Auth constraint on search.
dimension_scores.evidence: Utilized secure ORM queries in links_service.py and verified auth requirements in test_search.py.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced a hard cap on page_size (limit=100) to protect database memory and prevent Denial of Service (DoS) attacks on unbounded queries.
dimension_scores.evidence: Capped page limit to 100 in FastAPI route query parameters.

dimension_scores.observation: Communicated tradeoffs between DB-native search and dedicated search engines clearly, detailing data sync lag and complexity costs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Detailed pagination off-by-one errors and search engine operational overhead cleanly.

strengths: Implemented clean and robust offset-limit pagination with query param capping (limit=100) to defend against heavy query DoS vectors.
Prevented SQL injection by strictly leveraging SQLAlchemy parameter binding instead of using unsafe raw string construction.
data.recommendation: As search volume grows, keep track of query performance using EXPLAIN ANALYZE and consider adding pg_trgm indices.

public_evidence.student_action: Implemented GET /links/search route with query parameters and pagination validators.
public_evidence.technical_detail: FastAPI Query parameter ge/le constraints cap query limit to 100 max.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Ensures query retrieval remains fast and secure, capping maximum result sizes to prevent server exhaustion.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Implemented tags/substring filtering on links search endpoint.
Postgres-backed search query scoped strictly to owner_id.

teaching_approaches.detail: Analyzed search pagination boundaries and injection vulnerabilities.
